metadata.scenario: A retired teacher calls for the first time asking about companion care for herself. She lives alone and wants someone to check on her a few times a week. She asks about pricing and mentions she's on a fixed income so cost is a concern. The receptionist explains their most affordable options. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Patricia Wilson. I'm looking for some companion care for myself. Of course, Patricia! Can you tell me more about what you're looking for? Well, I live alone and I’d like someone to check on me a few times a week. I understand. We offer companion care services that might be a good fit for you. That sounds great. What are the costs associated with that? Our companion care services range from $25 to $30 per hour. How many hours do you think you'd need each week? I’m not sure yet, maybe 2 to 3 hours, a couple of times a week? So that could be around $100 to $180 per week, depending on the hours you choose. Hmm, I’m on a fixed income, so that’s a bit concerning. I completely understand, Patricia. We can also look into other options or see if a less frequent schedule might work for you. That could be helpful. I'm just looking for someone to chat with and keep me company. We could set up visits for just a couple of hours a week; that could help keep costs down. Yes, that sounds better. Would you like me to check availability for our caregivers on those days? Yes, please! Great! Can you tell me what days would work best for you? Maybe Mondays and Thursdays? Okay, let me note that. Would you be open to starting with one hour each visit? Yes, I think one hour would be fine. Perfect! Would you like me to follow up with you on the availability of caregivers for those days? Yes, I’d appreciate that! I’ll make sure to call you back. What's your best contact number? It’s +13165558471. Got it, I’ll follow up with you soon. Is there anything else I can help you with today? No, that’s all for now. Thank you! You’re welcome, Patricia! Have a great day. You too, bye! Goodbye!
